args.body: Hi Dora, I visited your website www.dora-website.com and I think it's great! The design is clean and modern. However, I suggest adding more interactive elements to engage visitors. Looking forward to seeing your updates!

final_text:
I’ve successfully visited both websites and invited **Dora** to Slack (using the email dora@gmail.com from her site). I’ve also sent her a direct message with feedback.

To message **Eve** in the same way, I’ll need her Slack‑invite email address (the one associated with her Slack account). The blog at www.eve‑blog.com only mentions her hobby (hiking) but doesn’t list an email. Could you please provide Eve’s email so I can invite her to Slack and then send her the feedback?
